authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored the existing unbound static worker and its backend adapters; this is a source-interface assessment, not independent numerical admission.
conclusion: Proposed sufficient shift is algebraically consistent, conditional on matched operator definitions and qualified numerical envelopes. Existing worker omits the new terms and must remain unbound; a future version must declare its scope and formula before execution.

algebra.S: sqrt(alpha)-normalized real-space plus self plus candidate-specific H, symmetric on the actual active positive-alpha coordinates
algebra.R_even: Exact-arithmetic reciprocal operator formed from stored real scatter/gather coefficients and conceptual q_even; independent channels and PSD when the stated sign/adjoint hypotheses hold
algebra.raw_reciprocal_upper: U_R=M*max(abs(q))*min(c1*cinf,cF), using actual stored q, not q_even
algebra.application_allowance: e_app>=0, with an explicit qualification authority and stated operator/application-norm scope; currently unavailable, not zero
algebra.sufficient_test: Positive S-tau*I implies the intended lower-margin requirement after the declared perturbation allowances, under the matched upper/lower assumptions. The scalar threshold remains 1e-6.
algebra.no_double_count: delta_odd is not added again to U_star because U_R already bounds the raw stored multiplier.
algebra.symmetry_scope: Oddness allowance addresses departure from the intended independent-channel operator. It does not replace native adjoint, symmetry, or channel-correspondence checks. An unqualified nonsymmetric floating application must not be relabeled as an SPD matrix.

minimal_future_contract: Bind exact candidate/composition, geometry/cell/grid/Ewald/boundary, active site and coordinate ordering, native intrinsic alpha and PCG-floor convention, stored snapshot, real-operator producer and all review/source pins. U_B must include this candidate H, not the old H=0 symbolic fixture.

Name U_R as the raw stored-multiplier bound. Retain q_min, q_negative_count, q_zero, nonfinite checks, actual conjugate discrepancy, c1/cinf/cF/M and delta_odd. Negative q or unsupported stencil/adjoint scope cannot silently pass the PSD route.

Add explicit e_app value-or-null, qualification pin, units=dimensionless normalized operator norm, channel space, algorithm/runtime/settings scope, and whether it covers reciprocal application only. Do not infer it from PCG convergence, the tiny fixture maximum error, 1e-11 entrywise comparison tolerance, or factor backward error.

Retain existing symmetry and sparse factor-action/solve checks, warning handling, exact strict spectral threshold and boundary/inconclusive distinctions. These are separate numerical checks, not additive application-error estimates.

Record the chosen formula and all scalar inputs before factorization. No automatic zero substitution, post-result allowance tuning, multiplier symmetrization, eigenvalue repair or repeated factor attempt.

Keep missing application qualification explicit. Operator-only initialization remains useful with e_app=null. A separately declared represented-operator-only numerical study may use tau=1e-6*(U_B+U_R)+delta_odd and label application-aware stability unqualified; it must not claim the full application-aware result. This is a scope choice for root, not an execution authorization or fallback in the current worker.
ordinary_double_limits: The sufficient inequalities are exact algebra conditional on the stated envelopes. Actual SNAPSHOT bounds and factor diagnostics are ordinary-double estimates; retain that label instead of claiming an outward-rounded certificate.

No formal interval factorization/inverse proof is introduced as a mandatory gate. Numerical bound accumulation, factor residuals and application qualification remain distinct; an unsupported application allowance is not manufactured to obtain a pass.
A failed shifted-real factor is inconclusive for full PME stability because the positive reciprocal part may rescue an indefinite real split. Resource/backend failure is not physical instability.
Successful static numerical qualification does not establish periodic energies/forces, response integration, physical accuracy, MD stability or factor-per-MD-step feasibility.
